rv.q: I urge all fans of DMV theatre to attend this incredibly important and deeply memorable production.
Round House Theatre's Ma Rainey's Black Bottom brings memory, survival, history, and a deeply human desire to be heard into intimate focus.
The few songs, like Ma, are worth the wait, and the magnificent performances reach toward something like salvation, without ever quite getting there.

Ma Rainey's Black Bottom Round House Theatre Previews Sep 9, 2026. Opens Sep 16, 2026. Closes Oct 18, 2026. Maryland Play · Published on September 25, 2026. Get tickets → An electrifying and richly layered production of August Wilson's classic that darkly depicts the soul of creation and the grit of ambition.
